New blueprint plan `blueprint/app-instances-as-members/`: makes plain workspace apps multi-instance in the default-workspace-template system_interface -- numbered per-app instances (`files-1`, `files-2`) as first-class members with refs `service:<name>?instance=<app>-<N>`, derived existence (an instance lives while any project or saved layout references it), uniform Delete, service verbs reachable from instance menus, Everything listing every app as a fixed shortcut row, and a location beacon in the vendored dufs frontend so file-viewer instances reopen at the folder they were viewing. Deferred consolidation of chats/terminals/browsers onto the same seam is tracked in default-workspace-template issue #481.
